provisions.title: Where ADUs are allowed in single-dwelling zones

scope.scope_quote: An accessory dwelling unit may be added to a house in RF through R2.5 zones.
Tree preservation requirements apply when trees are present on the site.
Large flag lots have required building setbacks that are the same along all lot lines.

provisions.title: Maximum living area for an ADU

scope.scope_quote: The maximum living area for an ADU is 75 percent of the living area of the primary structure or 800 square feet, whichever is less.

provisions.title: Maximum height for detached covered accessory structures

scope.scope_quote: The maximum height allowed for all detached covered accessory structures is 20 feet.
The required building setbacks are stated in Table 110-4.

provisions.title: ADU setback from front lot line or behind rear wall

scope.scope_quote: Detached ADUs must be at least 40 feet from a front lot line or behind the rear wall of the primary structure.

provisions.title: Maximum combined coverage for detached covered accessory structures

scope.scope_quote: The combined building coverage of all detached covered accessory structures may not exceed 20 percent of the total area of the site.
The maximum combined building coverage for all covered structures on the site is stated in Table 110-5.

provisions.title: Side and rear setback exception for detached covered accessory structures

scope.scope_quote: In R7, R5, and R2.5 zones, detached covered accessory structures are allowed in the side and rear building setbacks if all of the following are met.
